system.description:
You whip your flail into the air, rotating it at breakneck speeds until you create an impenetrable barrier of steel and chain. When you or an ally within range would take damage, you quickly leap into action by deflecting the incoming attacks. Allies gain +4 AC to the triggering attack, and +2 to AC for subsequent attacks until the beginning of your next turn.

Chain 2: If an allied creature taking damage triggers this jutsu, reduce the triggering damage by an amount equal to your [Weapons damage] + 2d8.

Chain 3: If the damage you take triggers this jutsu, redirect some of the triggering damage by an amount equal to you [Weapons damage] + 2d6. Reduce the damage taken by the result and then select another creature in range and make a melee taijutsu attack dealing your [Weapons damage] + the result to that creature.
